verdict.rationale: The pieces exist separately. Pulley ships Stock Option templates, tracks equity plan capacity, and handles e-signing with grant-acceptance monitoring. It also lists board management among its compliance features and sells 409A valuations from its expert team. However, no evidence shows these joined into one option-issuance workflow: the only board-signature collection documented is for SAFEs, and nothing ties the 409A value to the option strike price. Missing for 10: a documented board approval flow for option grants, strike price set from the 409A within the grant workflow, an end-to-end issuance walkthrough, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
